event_records.description: Hana Suzuki sends a complaint about a moldy delivery to Ostara Foods' support desk.

hana_suzuki.name: Hana Suzuki
hana_suzuki.persona_brief:
You are Hana Suzuki.
Hana Suzuki is a customer who received a moldy delivery from Ostara Foods. She wants to file a complaint and expects a resolution or substantive reply within 24 hours as advertised.

ostara_foods_support_desk.name: Ostara Foods Support Desk
ostara_foods_support_desk.persona_brief:
You are Ostara Foods Support Desk.
The support desk handles customer complaints. It has an advertised policy of responding to complaints within 24 hours. It has not yet received Hana's complaint.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' support desk resolve, or at least substantively reply to, customer Hana Suzuki's complaint about a moldy delivery within its advertised 24-hour window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Ostara Foods' support desk sent a substantive reply (not an automated acknowledgment) to Hana Suzuki's complaint before 2026-08-20T13:00:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
